---
name: Bounded Factory work item
about: Coordinate a decision or deliverable without duplicate mail
---

## Outcome and scope

What should be true when this work is finished? What is explicitly excluded?

## Roles and authority

Action owner, participants, current task/authority and retained gates.
A GitHub assignee or copied role is not a permission grant.

## Evidence and decisions

Link current state, candidate PRs, actual tests and decisions. Record exact targets
where relevant. Do not attach private assignments, operating histories or secrets.

## Result / open work

Observed result, unresolved findings, next action owner and acceptance status.
No preliminary ACK or parallel mailbox bookkeeping is required for this workflow.
